mapper.select: SELECT s.STORE_NO AS storeNo, s.STORE_NAME AS storeName, s.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, c.KOR AS sCategoryName, s.S_ADDR AS sAddr, pm.MENU_NAME AS popularMenuName FROM STORE s JOIN RESERVATION r ON s.STORE_NO = r.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN CODE c ON s.S_CATEGORY = c.VALUE AND c.TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STORE_NO, MENU_NAME FROM ( SELECT m.STORE_NO, m.MENU_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STORE_NO ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, m.MENU_NO ASC ) AS rn FROM RESERVATION r JOIN STORE_MENU m ON r.MENU_NO = m.MENU_NO GROUP BY m.STORE_NO, m.MENU_NO, m.MENU_NAME ) x WHERE rn = 1 ) pm ON s.STORE_NO = pm.STORE_NO GROUP BY s.STORE_NO, s.STORE_NAME, s.S_CATEGORY, c.KOR, s.S_ADDR, pm.MENU_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(r.RSV_NO) DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, p.I_SUB_NO AS iSubNo, pf.FILE_PATH AS filePath, pf.FILE_NAME AS fileName FROM PRODUCT p JOIN WISH w ON p.PRODUCT_NO = w.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE pf ON p.PRODUCT_NO = pf.PRODUCT_NO AND pf.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE p.PRODUCT_STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.I_SUB_NO, pf.FILE_PATH, pf.FILE_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(w.WISH_NO) DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT s.STORE_NO AS storeNo, s.STORE_NAME AS storeName, s.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, s.S_ADDR AS sAddr, c.KOR AS sCategoryName FROM STORE s LEFT JOIN CODE c ON s.S_CATEGORY = c.VALUE AND c.TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY' WHERE s.S_STATUS != 'EXT' AND s.S_CATEGORY = #{category} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 4
SELECT A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType FROM PC_ANIMAL_MAIN ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO ASC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, pam.A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, pam.A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB pas ON pas.A_SUB_NO = p.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN pam ON pam.A_MAIN_NO = pas.A_MAIN_NO WHERE pam.A_MAIN_NO = #{aMainNo} AND p.PRODUCT_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 4

SELECT STORE_NO AS storeNo, STORE_NAME AS storeName, S_ADDR AS sAddr, S_CATEGORY AS sCategory FROM STORE WHERE S_STATUS != 'EXT' AND S_CATEGORY = #{sCategory} AND ( STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY STORE_NAME ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STORE WHERE S_STATUS != 'EXT' AND S_CATEGORY = #{sCategory} AND ( STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.BRAND AS brand, PAM.A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType, PAS.A_SUB_TYPE AS aSubType, PIS.I_SUB_TYPE AS iSubType FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB PIS ON PIS.I_SUB_NO = P.I_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB PAS ON PAS.A_SUB_NO = P.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN PAM ON PAM.A_MAIN_NO = PAS.A_MAIN_NO WHERE ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.BRAND LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAM.A_MAIN_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAS.A_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PIS.I_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB PIS ON PIS.I_SUB_NO = P.I_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB PAS ON PAS.A_SUB_NO = P.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN PAM ON PAM.A_MAIN_NO = PAS.A_MAIN_NO WHERE ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.BRAND LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAM.A_MAIN_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAS.A_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PIS.I_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title, B.B_CONTENT AS bContent, BTS.B_MAIN_NO AS bMainNo FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO WHERE BTS.B_MAIN_NO = #{bMainNo} AND ( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO WHERE BTS.B_MAIN_NO = #{bMainNo} AND ( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
